scope: All 24 accepted rubric20 Q19 score labels, quality notes and semantic analyses were read for representation-based objections. Input field locations are linked for follow-up. This is a rationale inspection, not a complete semantic adjudication or rerating.
rule: Complete textual provenance and a W3C PROV-O graph are both permitted. A structured serialization, typed derivation field or programmatic traversal is not required solely as a representation preference. Missing substantive relationships or other Q19 content can still matter.
qualification: Treat flagged Q19 values, recorded totals and summaries containing them as unadjudicated model measurements. Mechanical acceptance does not establish semantic adherence. No point adjustment, corrected total, new instrument or new evaluator call is made. Unflagged entries are not certified correct.

observations.observation: The machine_annotation_tools descriptions map named software to generated feature families.
The acquisition description links all distributed features to standardized audio through b2aiprep.
The external resource description identifies b2aiprep as converting raw waveforms to Parquet features and merging source data into phenotype files.

cases.q19_score_label: Full provenance in text: entity-activity-agent relationships, processing lineage and derivation paths
cases.q19_quality_note: The 5-point band is met on all three of its stated components, expressed as text, which the rubric explicitly accepts in place of a serialized PROV-O graph. The lineage is complete rather than illustrative: each of the nine raw sources can be traced from the instrument that produced it, through the named conversion and the QC step, to the directory it occupies in the release, and the agents responsible at each stage are identified by role with their authority over the data stated. Quality documentation reinforces integrity with physically grounded anomaly causes and a documented missing-data regime.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: The provenance account reconciles with every other part of the record: the nine raw sources correspond one-to-one with the nine collection mechanisms and the nine datatype file_collections, and each declared target format matches the conforms_to_standard value for its collection. Version lineage is coherent, with the is_new_version_of relationships matching the version_access history. Two gaps are worth recording without moving the score: was_derived_from and parent_datasets are not populated as fields, their content being carried by raw_data_sources and related_datasets instead; and no checksums or fixity values are published, so file counts and byte totals are the only integrity handles for a 3.82 TB transfer. Those totals do at least reconcile internally to the byte, which is itself an integrity signal.

cases.q19_score_label: Well beyond version history, short of a complete derivation graph in typed fields
cases.q19_quality_note: Substantially more than the band-3 description of version history alone. A reader can trace each released directory back to a named device export, through a named conversion, to a named standard, under named responsible agents (site data managers, site PIs approving edits, the central project team, the UW NORC laboratory, the UAB biorepository). What is missing is the typed representation: derivation lives in prose across raw_data_sources and preprocessing_strategies rather than in was_derived_from or parent_datasets edges, and the RO-Crate that would carry FAIRscape provenance is referenced without its content being transcribed. Held at 4.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Assessed against the rubric's allowance that provenance may be text rather than PROV-O, the entity-activity-agent triad is largely recoverable: entities are the device-native exports and the released standardized files, activities are the conversions, the OMOP mapping, the Safe Harbor stripping and the two QC stages, agents are the site and central personnel named in data_collectors and cleaning_strategies. Cross-version lineage is carried by related_datasets is_new_version_of rather than parent_datasets, which is semantically equivalent but not the field the question names. Integrity is further supported by the anomalies block, which documents known quality defects per device candidly (Optomed image variability without dilation, FLIO movement sensitivity and end-of-visit fatigue, Garmin charging gaps), and by the disclosure that raw pre-standardization data are retained but not shared — so the lineage terminates at a stated boundary rather than trailing off.

cases.q19_score_label: Substantially beyond version history; lineage complete in prose but not graph-traversable at artifact level
cases.q19_quality_note: Clearly exceeds the 3-point anchor of version history alone: derivation from the parent study, typed version lineage, raw-to-processed transformation paths and a named agent for each processing activity are all present, as is a reference to a FAIRSCAPE provenance package. Held at 4 because the 5-point anchor asks for a full provenance graph: no field links a specific derived artifact to the specific raw input and activity that produced it, the RO-Crate that would carry those edges is described as distributed outside the release and is absent from the nine root metadata files, and no errata mechanism is recorded.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Read across fields, the entity-activity-agent triad is recoverable and correct — raw device exports (entities) are transformed by named conversions and OMOP/DICOM mapping (activities) performed by site coordinators, site data managers, site principal investigators and the central project team (agents), with authority boundaries stated, notably that editing occurred 'only under the guidance and approval of the site principal investigator'. Integrity signals are unusually strong on the quality side: REDCap range checks at entry, a data-manager sign-off before upload, an internal PII review, and dqd_omop.json enabling 3,500+ OMOP quality checks by the reuser. Integrity is also demonstrated rather than asserted through arithmetic that closes — file counts reconcile exactly to 356,343 — and through the disclosure of the one figure that does not, the 419,614-byte size gap. Raw data retention is handled candidly: raw exports are preserved but not shared because they are unmapped and 'may accidentally include personal health information ... for example in free text fields', which is a sound reason and leaves the lineage's first hop documented but unreachable.

cases.q19_score_label: Substantial textual lineage with agents and processing steps, short of a complete derivation graph
cases.q19_quality_note: This sits clearly above the version-history-only anchor. The rubric accepts prose provenance, and what is here is a real processing lineage with identifiable entities (raw device exports, converted standard-format files, the packaged release), activities (conversion, terminology mapping, QC, PII review, packaging) and agents (named site and central roles), plus derivation paths to two prior versions and one derived subset. It falls short of the top band because the lineage must be assembled by the reader from four separate fields rather than being expressed as a graph, the two schema slots built for derivation (`was_derived_from`, `parent_datasets`) are empty, no errata mechanism exists, and the step-to-step mapping is not explicit — the reader cannot tell which activity produced which collection, or which agent authorized which transformation.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Integrity is independently supported by the arithmetic reconciliation noted under Q5: file counts and byte totals cross-check against per-collection figures, which is direct evidence that the release is internally accounted for. The RO-Crate 1.2 packaging is provenance-capable and, if it carries the relationships in machine-readable form, the underlying artifact may exceed what this record exposes — but the record does not assert that, so it is not credited. The v3.0.0 removal of Snellen acuity variables is correctly surfaced under known_limitations as an integration_limitation, which is the kind of breaking-change disclosure errata would otherwise carry.

cases.q19_score_label: Textual provenance with lineage and agents; version history and missingness absent
cases.q19_quality_note: Lineage is genuinely traceable: for each of the five modalities a reader can follow source system to extraction activity to standardization activity to released format, with the performing agents and the governing SOPs named. That is a complete derivation path expressed in text, which the rubric accepts on equal footing with a PROV-O graph, and it exceeds the 3 band - which describes version history without lineage - by inversion. Held at 4 rather than 5 because the integrity half of the question is largely unanswered: no version_access, no errata channel, no missing_data_documentation despite known_limitations confirming modality availability is uneven, and no structured was_derived_from or parent_datasets linkage. Data quality assurance is real but one-directional, consisting of characterization reports returned to sites with no report of residual quality after correction.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Mapped to W3C PROV-O, the record supplies all three node types and the edges between them: entities (source EHR/PACS/monitor/EEG records, intermediate extracts, released OMOP/DICOM/WFDB/EDF+/OHNLP artifacts), activities (extraction, standardization, tokenization, waveform conversion, geocoding, characterization, semantic mapping validation), and agents (contributing hospitals, site data managers, the consortium). What is missing is the formal expression and, more consequentially, the temporal binding - no derivation is dated or versioned, so the lineage describes how the data were made but not which instance of them any user holds. The absence of missing_data_documentation is the sharpest inconsistency in this question: known_limitations.coverage_limitation states that imaging de-identification and EEG extraction were in process and that metadata was unpublished for notes, imaging, and EEG, which is a description of systematic missingness that the dedicated field leaves unrecorded.

cases.q19_score_label: Very good — near-complete textual lineage from source to release, but no derivation fields and no version history
cases.q19_quality_note: The rubric accepts textual provenance, and the entity-activity-agent triad is genuinely reconstructible here: entities (hospital EHR, PACS, bedside monitors, EEG database, notes), activities (extraction, OMOP mapping, tokenization, deidentification, waveform conversion, characterization), and agents (named contributing sites and consortium sub-teams) are each documented, with derivation paths traceable per modality from source system to released format. Scored 4 rather than 5 because the dedicated derivation fields (was_derived_from, parent_datasets) are empty, the lineage is narrative rather than graph-structured or machine-readable, and the version-history component of the field set is entirely absent.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Lineage completeness is the record's strength: every one of the five released distribution_formats can be traced back through a preprocessing strategy to a named raw_data_source and forward to its access posture, and the modality accounting closes consistently across raw_data_sources, collection_mechanisms, instances and distribution_formats. The notes pathway is documented with unusual care, including the fact that the source entity never leaves the contributing site and only the tokenized derivative enters the enclave, which is exactly the derivation detail a provenance consumer needs. Two deficits keep it from 5. First, the provenance is not addressable: with no was_derived_from, no parent_datasets, no identifiers on the source entities, and no version on the output, the lineage cannot be resolved to specific artifacts, so it documents a process rather than the origin of a particular release. Second, integrity and quality signals are thin: no errata, no missing_data_documentation, and no anomalies, despite high-frequency flowsheet and waveform data where gaps and sensor dropout are intrinsic. The holdout split is described in prose but subsets.is_data_split is not set, so the split is not machine-detectable.

cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Assessed against W3C PROV-O in the textual form the rubric permits: entities are identifiable (source EHR records, PACS images, monitor telemetry, EEG recordings, the tokenized and OMOP-mapped enclave tables), activities are named (extraction, OHNLP tokenization, OMOP semantic mapping, imaging de-identification, waveform conversion, DeGauss geocoding), and agents are attributed (14 contributing sites, site data managers, clinical collaborators, named tools). What is missing is the linkage layer: no field connects the released dataset to its antecedents as typed derivations, so the graph must be reconstructed by a reader rather than traversed. The absence of missing_data_documentation is a quality gap with real analytic consequence for ICU data, where flowsheet and waveform missingness is pervasive and often informative, and it is compounded by the acknowledged partial-modality release.

Derivation is asserted rather than identified, however: nothing carries an identifier linking the released OMOP collection to a particular site extract or mapping version, so the graph is readable but not traversable. missing_information on the imaging and note instances supplies real gap documentation despite the dedicated field being empty.

cases.q19_quality_note: Above the 3-point band, which describes version history alone: this record adds real lineage in prose (deposition archive → pipeline; component data → MassIVE, SRA, Figshare), agent attribution to named laboratories, and per-file MD5 integrity. cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Entity-activity-agent material is genuinely present but distributed across slots that were not designed to carry a graph: entities in raw_data_sources and file_collections, activities in acquisition_methods (SEC-MS, AP-MS, ICC-IF, Perturb-seq), agents in data_collectors (Krogan lab UCSF, Lundberg Lab Stanford, UCSD). A reader can reconstruct lineage; a machine cannot traverse it, because the two slots that would encode derivation edges are unpopulated while the PROV-O content is asserted to live inside a downloadable ZIP. Integrity itself is the strongest element here — checksums for every artifact plus a DOI-versioned release chain. Two quality gaps bear on this question: missing_data_documentation is absent even though known_limitations concedes that the modalities 'interrogate sets of proteins which incompletely overlap', and the description's claim to include MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq data is contradicted by the embargo and by the manifest, which is an integrity defect in the record's account of its own contents.

cases.q19_semantic_analysis: The distinction the question draws between version history and provenance is exactly the distinction this record straddles. Its version history is excellent and would alone earn 3; what lifts it is that EVI/PROV-style lineage is genuinely described and that agents, activities and entities are separately identified across data_collectors, acquisition_methods and raw_data_sources. Integrity signalling is also present and used analytically: source_caveats reports that the June 2026 image archives 'report the same file sizes as those in the October 2025 release but different MD5 checksums, indicating the archives were regenerated', and draws the correct inference of not carrying over the older per-file protein counts. Checksums themselves are not recorded in the datasheet.

cases.q19_quality_note: The rubric accepts text or graph representation provided lineage is complete, and lineage here is complete in the sense PROV-O requires: for each released column a reader can name the source entity, the activity that produced it, the agent that performed the activity, and the parameters used. That is materially more than the version history which defines the 3-band, and it is why this scores 5 rather than 3. parent_datasets is unpopulated, but the ancestral links it would carry are present as typed related_datasets entries and in raw_data_sources.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Provenance is corroborated by quality documentation rather than standing alone: the variables' quality_notes explain which records are absent and why ('Absent for recordings that contain free speech, for sensitive records and for audio checks'), and that explanation matches missing_data_documentation.missing_data_causes, the deidentification account, and the differing per-feature record counts in instances.notes. Four independent fields tell the same story about the same absences, which is the mark of a lineage record derived from the actual pipeline. Not serialised as RDF PROV-O, which the rubric expressly does not require.

cases.assessment: Original review finding: Q19 penalizes permitted textual provenance. VOICE rep3 additionally denies activity/entity/agent bindings that are explicit in the supplied record. No corrected score is inferred.
cases.q19_score_label: Very Good - lineage well beyond version history, but expressed as prose rather than as an entity-activity-agent structure
cases.q19_quality_note: This is materially more than the 3-band, which is version history alone: origins, processing lineage and derivation paths are all documented, and data quality is separately evidenced through the audit protocol and anomalies. It falls short of the 5-band because the two dedicated provenance fields are empty and the lineage is recoverable only by reading across preprocessing_strategies, raw_data_sources and related_datasets rather than from a structured entity-activity-agent representation.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: The rubric accepts text or W3C PROV-O graph form provided the lineage is complete, and the text here does name the three PROV-O roles in substance — entities (raw WAV at Synapse syn72370534, the nine Parquet feature files, the phenotype tables), activities (resampling, STFT, feature extraction, de-identification, BIDS conversion) and agents (b2aiprep v3.0.0, the named tool set, research teams and clinicians). What is missing is the binding between them: no field states which activity produced which entity under which agent, and with was_derived_from empty the derivation is machine-readable only through the related_datasets edge. One point is deducted for that gap, which is also recorded as a low-severity consistency issue.

cases.q19_score_label: Complete lineage in text form: entities, activities, agents and derivation paths
cases.q19_quality_note: The lineage is complete and traversable in text form, which the rubric accepts as equivalent to a graph when it supplies full lineage: for any released file a reader can name the source entity, the transforming activity with its parameters, the software agent that performed it and the release in which it changed. Integrity and quality are supported by per-recording QC metrics and a documented audit, and errata record concrete corrections including the 3.1.0 Parquet repair and diagnosis back-fill.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Derivation paths resolve per file rather than in aggregate — sparc_ema.parquet traces to the SPARC package and to the 16 kHz standardized waveform, ppgs.parquet to the ppgs package at 100 Hz, static_features.tsv to openSMILE/Praat/parselmouth — so entity-activity-agent relationships are recoverable without a formal PROV-O serialization. parent_datasets is empty, but the derives_from relationship carries the same information with a typed relation and a resolvable accession, so the absence does not break the chain. One residual limitation: the raw-audio entity is identified by Synapse accession only, since no DOI exists for it, which the record states explicitly.

cases.q19_score_label: Full provenance graph with entity-activity-agent relationships, processing lineage, and derivation paths
cases.q19_quality_note: Lineage is complete in the textual form the question permits: source entities are identified and resolvable, each transformation is named with its parameters and its executing software, and human and institutional agents are attributed to specific roles. Derivation paths extend beyond this release to its predecessor version, its concept record, its companion cohort and its raw source, each by resolvable identifier. Integrity and quality evidence (errata, audit protocol, per-recording quality metrics, missingness table) is present rather than promised.
cases.q19_semantic_analysis: The entity-activity-agent triad resolves without inference: entities are the Synapse waveforms and REDCap exports, the standardized 16 kHz audio and the nine feature tensors; activities are resampling, filtering, STFT and each extraction step with stated parameters; agents are b2aiprep 3.0.0, senselab, the named third-party tools, site clinicians and research teams, and the consortium. No W3C PROV-O serialization is offered, which the rubric expressly does not require. Provenance also explains observable properties of the data rather than standing apart from it: the unequal per-feature record counts follow from documented withholding rules and extraction failures, and the 3.1.0 errata about broken Parquet files and back-filled diagnoses tell a reuser what changed since 3.0.0. The absence of recommended splits is a documented design decision, not a gap, and the record says so twice.

cases.q19_quality_note: Above the version-history-only band: the record supports a complete derivation path from consented participant through raw waveform and named processing step to each released file, with the processing agent versioned. cases.q19_semantic_analysis: Provenance is expressed as text rather than a W3C PROV-O graph, which the rubric permits when lineage is complete, and it is: each output file can be traced to a tool, parameters and an upstream entity. Derivation claims are consistent with the exclusions - transcripts and free-speech-derived dense features are stated as withheld in both is_deidentified and known_limitations, and the per-feature record shortfalls are explained in anomalies. parent_datasets is unpopulated as a field, but its content is carried by was_derived_from and the typed derives_from relationship, so the lineage is not actually broken.
